sources.title: Electrical discharge machining
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 電化學精密加工
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付線中心補償圖、切縫表及內角可製造性判斷。；教學圖面內角 R≤0.08 mm，0.20 mm 線不合、0.10 mm 線在理想模型下可行。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver compensated wire-center geometry, kerf table and corner manufacturability decision.; For a teaching internal radius≤0.08 mm, 0.20 mm wire fails and 0.10 mm wire is theoretically feasible.
related.difference: 以法拉第定律建立電荷與移除質量的量綱關係，只作離線材料帳。
related.differenceEn: Use Faraday’s law to relate charge and removed mass in an offline material balance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 切縫 w=d+2g；簡化內角半徑 Rmin=d/2+g。；教學線徑 d=0.20 mm、側間隙 g=0.015 mm。；w=0.20+2×0.015=0.230 mm；Rmin=0.115 mm。
m=ηMQ/(zF)，M 為摩爾質量、z 為電子數、F 為法拉第常數。；教學理想化鐵二價溶解 M=55.845 g/mol、Q=193 C、z=2、F=96485 C/mol、η=1。；m=55.845×193/(2×96485)=0.0558537 g。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Kerf w=d+2g and simplified minimum internal radius Rmin=d/2+g.; Teaching wire diameter d=0.20 mm and side gap g=0.015 mm.; w=0.20+2×0.015=0.230 mm; Rmin=0.115 mm.

m=ηMQ/(zF), with molar mass M, electron number z and Faraday constant F.; Teaching idealized Fe(II) dissolution: M=55.845 g/mol, Q=193 C, z=2, F=96485 C/mol and η=1.; m=55.845×193/(2×96485)=0.0558537 g.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 熱等靜壓緻密化
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付線中心補償圖、切縫表及內角可製造性判斷。；教學圖面內角 R≤0.08 mm，0.20 mm 線不合、0.10 mm 線在理想模型下可行。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver compensated wire-center geometry, kerf table and corner manufacturability decision.; For a teaching internal radius≤0.08 mm, 0.20 mm wire fails and 0.10 mm wire is theoretically feasible.
related.difference: 辨認密度提升、內部缺陷閉合與表面連通孔之間的證據差異。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish evidence for bulk density, internal defect closure and surface-connected pores.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 切縫 w=d+2g；簡化內角半徑 Rmin=d/2+g。；教學線徑 d=0.20 mm、側間隙 g=0.015 mm。；w=0.20+2×0.015=0.230 mm；Rmin=0.115 mm。
以實體材料密度為基準，相對密度=1−孔隙體積率；相同金屬質量下尺寸變化須由體積比推導。 教學試片前後孔隙率為 2.0% 與 0.2%，初始體積 100 cm³，假設金屬質量不變。 Vafter=100×0.98/0.998=98.1964 cm³；體積下降 1.8036%，不能直接當成線收縮。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Kerf w=d+2g and simplified minimum internal radius Rmin=d/2+g.; Teaching wire diameter d=0.20 mm and side gap g=0.015 mm.; w=0.20+2×0.015=0.230 mm; Rmin=0.115 mm.

Relative density equals one minus void fraction on a solid-material basis; fixed-mass size change follows the volume ratio. Teaching porosity is 2.0% before and 0.2% after; initial volume 100 cm³ with unchanged metal mass. Vafter=100×0.98/0.998=98.1964 cm³; volume decreases 1.8036%, which is not the linear contraction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
